Carly, Sam, Freddie, and Spencer have been on an incredible journey together, from their web show adventures to facing the challenges of growing up... which, Spencer is still working on. But when Carly decides to move with her dad to Italy, it's time for the iCarly crew to say their goodbyes to each other - for now, at least! Watch the full final episode of iCarly, "iGoodbye," cut down to 10 minutes!
